faq.title: Got Questions?
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our services, treatments, and what to expect during your recovery journey.

faqs.question: Do I need a referral to book an appointment?
faqs.answer: No referral is necessary. You can book directly through our website or by calling our clinic. We welcome self-referrals and work with most health insurance providers.

faqs.question: What should I bring to my first visit?
faqs.answer: Please bring your ID, insurance card, any relevant medical records or imaging results, and a list of current medications. Comfortable clothing is recommended.

faqs.question: How do I schedule an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book online through our website, call us directly, or use our mobile app. Same-day appointments are often available for urgent cases.

faqs.question: How long does each session typically last?
faqs.answer: Initial assessments are 60 minutes. Follow-up treatment sessions are usually 45-60 minutes depending on your condition and treatment plan.

faqs.question: Is physiotherapy treatment painful?
faqs.answer: Physiotherapy should not be significantly painful. You may experience mild discomfort during treatment as we work on tight or injured tissues, but we always work within your comfort level.

faqs.question: What should I wear to my session?
faqs.answer: Wear comfortable, loose-fitting clothing that allows easy access to the area being treated. For lower body issues, shorts work best. For upper body, a tank top or loose t-shirt is ideal.

faqs.question: Do you accept insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes, we accept most major insurance plans. Contact our office with your insurance information and we'll verify your coverage and benefits before your appointment.

faqs.question: What are your payment options?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, major credit & debit cards and Bank Transfer. Payment plans are available for those without insurance coverage.

faqs.question: Will my insurance cover all treatments?
faqs.answer: Coverage varies by plan. Most insurance covers a certain number of physical therapy visits per year. We'll help you understand your benefits during your first visit.

faqs.question: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.answer: This varies widely depending on your condition. Some patients see significant improvement in 4-6 sessions, while chronic or complex conditions may require longer treatment plans.

faqs.question: Will I get exercises to do at home?
faqs.answer: Yes! Home exercises are a crucial part of your recovery. We provide personalized exercise programs and can send video demonstrations to your phone.

faqs.question: Is physiotherapy the same as chiropractic care?
faqs.answer: While there are overlaps, physiotherapy focuses on rehabilitation, movement re-education, and exercise therapy in addition to manual techniques, offering a more comprehensive approach.

faq.title: Common Service Questions
faq.description: Understanding your treatment plan is part of the healing process.

acuteInjuries.question: Which therapy is right for acute injuries?
acuteInjuries.answer: For acute injuries (occurring within the last 48-72 hours), we typically recommend starting with a diagnostic consultation followed by gentle Manual Therapy to manage inflammation and pain before progressing to active rehabilitation.

combineTreatments.question: Can I combine treatments?
combineTreatments.answer: Absolutely. Our approach is holistic. Most successful recovery plans involve a mix of Manual Therapy for immediate relief and Corrective Exercise for long-term prevention.

postOpPackages.question: Do you offer post-op packages?
postOpPackages.answer: Yes. Our Post-Surgical Rehab program is comprehensive. We bundle initial assessments, wound care checks, and a 12-week progressive strength track to get you back to normal life.

sportsRecovery.question: Is sports recovery only for professionals?
sportsRecovery.answer: Not at all. Whether you're a weekend warrior, a daily jogger, or an elite athlete, our Sports Recovery protocols are designed to help any active body recover faster and prevent injury.

manualTherapy.title: Manual Therapy
manualTherapy.metaDescription: Hands-on joint mobilization and soft tissue techniques for immediate pain relief and restored function.
manualTherapy.overview: Our certified manual therapists use evidence-based, hands-on techniques—including joint mobilization, soft tissue manipulation, and myofascial release—to restore optimal movement and reduce pain. Every session is tailored to your body's specific needs.
manualTherapy.whatToExpect: During your first visit, we perform a thorough assessment of your movement patterns, pain triggers, and medical history. Treatment begins with gentle mobilization techniques, progressing as your body responds. Most patients experience noticeable relief within the first 2–3 sessions.

sportsRecovery.title: Sports Recovery
sportsRecovery.metaDescription: Professional sports rehabilitation to get athletes back to peak performance with evidence-based protocols.
sportsRecovery.overview: From weekend warriors to professional athletes, our sports rehabilitation program combines cutting-edge biomechanical diagnostics with personalized recovery protocols. We address the root cause—not just the symptoms—to ensure a safe, lasting return to sport.
sportsRecovery.whatToExpect: We begin with a detailed biomechanical and sport-specific assessment. Your customized program gradually progresses from pain management through strength rebuilding to sport-specific drills—ensuring you return stronger and more resilient.

painManagement.title: Pain Management
painManagement.metaDescription: Comprehensive pain management strategies for chronic conditions using targeted interventions and holistic wellness.
painManagement.overview: Our multidisciplinary approach addresses the root causes of chronic pain through targeted manual interventions, therapeutic exercise, and education. We treat the whole person—not just the symptom—combining clinical expertise with a deep understanding of pain science.
painManagement.whatToExpect: Your journey begins with a comprehensive pain assessment including mapping triggers, movement patterns, and lifestyle factors. We develop a personalized multi-modal plan combining hands-on therapy with education to help you regain control of your life.

postSurgical.title: Post-Surgical Rehabilitation
postSurgical.metaDescription: Specialized rehabilitation following orthopedic surgeries to ensure optimal recovery timelines and outcomes.
postSurgical.overview: Our post-surgical protocols are designed in collaboration with leading orthopedic surgeons to ensure optimal recovery timelines and outcomes. We guide you through every phase—from early wound management to full functional restoration.
postSurgical.whatToExpect: We coordinate closely with your surgical team to begin rehabilitation at the optimal time. Early sessions focus on reducing swelling and restoring gentle movement, progressing systematically through a 12-week program with clear milestones.

activeAging.title: Active Aging
activeAging.metaDescription: Specialized physiotherapy for seniors focusing on mobility, fall prevention, and quality of life enhancement.
activeAging.overview: Our senior wellness program focuses on maintaining mobility, preventing falls, and enhancing quality of life through gentle, effective exercises. We believe aging should be active—not a decline. Every program is designed with respect for your body's evolving needs.
activeAging.whatToExpect: We start with a thorough mobility and balance assessment to identify risks and set realistic goals. Sessions combine gentle stretching, balance exercises, and functional strength training—all in a supportive, patient-centered environment.

hydrotherapy.title: Hydrotherapy
hydrotherapy.metaDescription: Low-impact aquatic resistance training to rebuild muscle without joint stress in our therapeutic pool.
hydrotherapy.overview: Our aquatic therapy program uses the unique properties of water—buoyancy, warmth, and resistance—to create the ideal rehabilitation environment. Patients recover faster with less pain, as water reduces joint loading by up to 90%.
hydrotherapy.whatToExpect: After a brief aquatic readiness check, you'll be guided through warm therapeutic water exercises tailored to your condition. The warmth relaxes muscles while buoyancy allows movements that may be impossible on land.

correctiveExercise.title: Corrective Exercise
correctiveExercise.metaDescription: Analytical assessment and resolution of biomechanical imbalances to prevent injuries and improve posture.
correctiveExercise.overview: Our corrective exercise specialists identify and address movement dysfunctions through targeted exercises and postural retraining. We use advanced movement screening to find the root cause of your pain—then fix it for good.
correctiveExercise.whatToExpect: We begin with a detailed Functional Movement Screen to identify asymmetries and dysfunctions. Your personalized program targets weak links in your movement chain, progressively building toward pain-free, efficient movement patterns.

neurological.title: Neurological Rehabilitation
neurological.metaDescription: Compassionate care for neurological conditions including stroke recovery, Parkinson's, and MS management.
neurological.overview: Our neurological rehabilitation team specializes in helping patients regain function and independence following strokes, brain injuries, and progressive conditions. We use neuroplasticity principles to rewire movement patterns and rebuild capabilities.
neurological.whatToExpect: We perform a thorough neurological assessment covering motor function, balance, coordination, and daily living abilities. Treatment is intensive and goal-oriented, using repetitive task training and neuroplasticity principles to maximize recovery potential.

pediatric.title: Pediatric Physiotherapy
pediatric.metaDescription: Gentle, play-based therapy tailored for children's developmental needs and milestones.
pediatric.overview: Our pediatric specialists create fun, engaging therapy sessions that help children reach their developmental milestones. Using play-based approaches, we make rehabilitation enjoyable while achieving meaningful clinical outcomes for your child.
pediatric.whatToExpect: Sessions are designed to feel like play, not work. We assess your child's developmental stage, create games that target specific goals, and coach parents on supporting progress at home. Children typically love their therapy sessions!
